limitations: Only T+3B (P53) has VERIFIED max_cells_per_line. Other canonicals are estimates pending POC validation.
Image-into-placeholder operations require daemon-side Slides API (Iteration 2). FULL-IMG works via gog slides replace-slide.
Master/header text (Presentation name / YYYY) not editable via gog. Iteration 2 daemon API needed.

preferred_per_scenario._priority_note: RULE PRECEDENCE (Round 10/12): image_marker_layout_constraint > preferred_per_scenario. If outline section contains an [image:] marker AND has body text, the canonical MUST be T+IMG family — overriding any scenario-based preference below. The scenario hint applies ONLY when there is no [image:] marker. See SKILL.md §3.0.6.
preferred_per_scenario.cover: T+SUB or T-ONLY (avoid COVER?, multiple placeholders bleed)
preferred_per_scenario.highlights_3: T+3B (P53 verified) — UNLESS [image:] marker present, then T+IMG (P31)
preferred_per_scenario.highlights_5: T+5B — UNLESS [image:] marker present, then T+IMG (P31) and split bullets across pages if needed
preferred_per_scenario.kpi_summary: T+3B with each metric as a bullet (avoid T-LONG, that is for quotes) — UNLESS [image:] marker present in the same section, then T+IMG (P31). Image-marker rule wins; never silently drop the image. Round 10 regression: agent picked T+3B for a KPI section that also had [image:], image disappeared.
preferred_per_scenario.product_launch_announcement: T+IMG (hero) or T+SUB (text-heavy). If [image:] marker present, force T+IMG.
preferred_per_scenario.process_steps: T+5B (numbered) — UNLESS [image:] marker present, then T+IMG (process visual as image)
preferred_per_scenario.quote: T-LONG (P26) — keep brackets. UNLESS [image:] marker present, then T+IMG (omit quote brackets, image as the visual anchor).
preferred_per_scenario.closing: T-ONLY (P110, kept short to fit oversized placeholder font)
preferred_per_scenario.two_paragraph_notes: T+SUB (P28) — reuse same canonical as KPI summary if needed; do NOT use T+2B (P54) which has 4 arrow positions and shows 2 empty arrows when only 2 are filled. Round 4 user feedback. UNLESS [image:] marker present, then T+IMG (P31).

closing_text_recommendation.rationale: Placeholder is designed for English Thank you. — JP full-width 5 chars don't fit at the same font size and wrap to 2 lines (Round 3 user feedback).
avoid: ありがとうございました (12 fullwidth, severely overflows)

canonical_strict_mode.rule: Use ONLY shape_canonicals[X].canonical_slide_id for shape X. NEVER browse all_layouts for alternative P-numbers with the same shape signature. all_layouts is REFERENCE DATA only — for understanding what slides exist in the source deck, NOT a layout pool.
canonical_strict_mode.rationale: Round 4 regression: agent picked P59 (05 People divider) and P109 (010 Closers divider) for content sections (<brand-project> / Next Month). Those P-numbers have T-ONLY shape but are section dividers without header/WIX logo. Strict canonical-only avoids this entire class of mistake.

image_marker_layout_constraint.rule_v2: If outline section has [image: ...] marker: (a) section has body text after the marker → use T+IMG (P31 or P83 alt) ONLY. (b) section has only the [image:] marker with no body text → FULL-IMG (P33) is OK. Never use FULL-IMG when body text exists; never use T-LONG/T+SUB when image exists.
image_marker_layout_constraint.rationale: Round 5 regression: agent picked FULL-IMG for <industry-event> (had body text "4/8-10 ビッグサイト出展...") — body text disappeared. Round 4 regression: T-LONG for same section — image disappeared.
image_marker_layout_constraint.preferred_canonical_for_image_with_body: T+IMG (P31 default; P83 alt for paragraph-style body)

skill_guidance.title_fit_rule: Match outline section title length (in cells: fullwidth JP=2, latin=1) to the canonical's title_fit.ideal. Reject canonicals where title length < title_fit.min (page looks empty) or > title_fit.max (title wraps). When multiple canonicals fit, prefer the one whose ideal is closest to actual.
